content: Presidio (now at presidio.dataprivacystack.org): analyzer combines NER, regex, rule logic, checksums and context words across languages; deny-list, ad-hoc and custom recognizers; allow-lists; anonymizer operators incl. replace/redact/mask/hash/encrypt with decrypt, custom operators and a pseudonymization sample; image redactor via OCR incl. DICOM; structured/CSV batch; PII-detection evaluation guide. Explicit caveat: no guarantee Presidio finds all sensitive information, additional safeguards required.
